description: Get retained county assessment observations and source provenance for a supported address or parcel ID. Missing facts stay unavailable; commercial source area is not finished living area. Any comparison is a draft with evidence holds and does not establish personal tax savings or filing readiness.

actual_sqft.description: Optional: Actual measured living area in sq ft

address.description: Alternative alias for property street address

address_or_pidn.description: Full street address or county parcel ID (e.g. '3731 Anderson Ave, Chattanooga, TN' or '157I L 001')

county_key.description: Optional exact registered county adapter key, such as hamilton. Restricts lookup to that county and avoids unrelated county scans; conflicting explicit prefixes are rejected.

notice_appraised_value.description: Optional: New proposed appraised value from reassessment notice

name: get_property_assessment
